greeting.text: I am Fuegoleon Vermillion, captain of the Crimson Lion. Be welcome in the Sanctuary, {player}.
A delver, then. The dungeon has need of those who keep their heads. Do you?
Fire is a good servant and a terrible master. I would be glad to see you learn the difference.
Your deeds reached the Sanctuary before you did, {player}. It is an honour to meet you.
Good to see you on your feet.

hint.text: A flame with no purpose is only a fire. Decide what you protect, and let the heat follow.
I was struck down once, badly. It taught me what the people behind me are worth. Fight with them, not around them.
The spirit of fire does not lend its power to the careless. Earn it, and take care of it.
My sister Mereoleona has more strength than patience, and my brother Leopold more heart than caution. Between them they keep me humble.
Every boss shows its blow before it lands. A calm eye sees the warning; a hot head sees only the target.
Hold the line together. A party that retreats together can always return.
Start small, {player}. A guardian on the early floors is still a guardian. There is no shame in bringing company.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun is patient and cruel. Do not let them choose the ground you fight on.
One of the Eye's blades is broken. It is a start, not the end of it.
The Spade Kingdom fights in a way we do not. Do not meet gravity with stubbornness; go around it.
To face Lucius is to face a man who has already thought of your next move. Show him one he has not.
I am told there are warriors in the Chronicle who answer to no kingdom at all. I would be glad to learn from them, and to stand beside them.

farewell.text: Go with fire in your heart and a cool head.
The Crimson Lion stands behind you.
